notes.title: 1.9.6 colorful coordinate update
notes.content:
Updated to 1.9.6.
A color coordination feature has been added that allows you to change the color of Hazumi's hair, pubic hair, and eyes.
Two new items have been added to the pharmacy after starting the game. Purchase them and then check the mirror in your room.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36763405/43da27b22a286baee0e73cf12ef63156f6604869.png[/img]

Because of changes in the way pictures are loaded, there may be compatibility issues with existing mods.
If the pictures do not display properly, try putting the official mod "LegacyParts" in the Official_Mods folder.
It will revert the images to the loading method used up to 1.7, so previous mods should also work.

If you still have problems, you can downgrade to v1.7.4.
Right-click "Hazzumi and the Land of Childbirth" from the library of the Steam app -> Properties
→select [old1.7] from the Beta tab.

notes.title: ver1.8.1 beta
notes.content:
# v1.8.1 beta
## add
- Added a makeover function
  - Hair, eyebrow, eyes, and pubic hair color now be changed freely.
    - Color changes are reflected in the character sprite, character CG, and prostitution event CGs. The ending CG is not changed. 
  - Because the method of displaying character and event CGs has changed significantly since v1.7, a $cheat.LegacyParts option has been added for compatability. Mods created up to v1.7 are installed by adding to the \Official_Mods\LegacyParts folder, then copying that to the PPLSS/www/mods folder.
- Added existing facial expressions to the character CG viewer that could not be viewed previously.

In order to minimize the impact of the glitch, I have distributed 1.8 using the Steam beta feature for a while.
From the Steam app library, right-click on "Hazumi and the Pregnation" -> Properties -> Beta tab and select "beta - Beta test version" to update to the beta version.

Before updating to the beta version, right-click on "Hazumi and the Pregnation" in the Steam library → Manage → Browse Local Files → Backup the PPLSS/www/save folder.

If you find any bugs, please contact me at [url=https://twitter.com/mihiraghi]@mihiraghi[/url].

notes.title: ver1.6.2
notes.content:
I'm glad to see so many Hazumi mods being made.
However, I've seen a lot of people stumble over the introduction of mods. So I've decided to update to make it easier.

The DLsite version will be updated beginning of the next week.

[h3]ver1.6 changes:[/h3]

it was inconvenient to have two folders for installing mods, I integrated them into the "PPLSS/www/mods" folder.
Both js-mod and database-mod will be read automatically should you put them in "www/mods".
And therefore "js/mods" and "data/mods" folders have been removed.
It is compatible with 1.4 and 1.5, so players can use it by creating each folders.

Installation: 
Steam app -> right click on "Hazumi and the Pregnation" -> management -> browse local files -> copy the mods to PPLSS/www/mods folder.
Image files still need to be placed directly; if the mod include img folder , copy it to www/img.

There is no longer an alert when mods are conflicting.
Modders can continue to check in console.error().

Added The allComposeJSON() command.
You can use it to view databases created by other modders on your RPG maker MV editor.
